rolled_back_to: cnn10_v110.py (逐字父本；v112 的视图群轴实测判负（10 视图 -0.18pp、角位比中心位 -0.4575pp）⇒ 回退优先：先回 v110 训练态，再换约束通道 pinn 的作用面)
axis: v113 = cnn10_v110.py's training math VERBATIM except ONE axis: the ACTION SURFACE of the physics constraint term `pinn`. In GradientStablePhysResNetV3.forward, pinn (the physics-constraint term that penalizes roughness of the final feature map) is computed on `deep` = the layer4 output, i.e. AFTER gate3 has INJECTED the physics field. Because Gate.forward is `feat + scale * a * bn(proj(phys))`, the gradient of pinn therefore flows deep -> gate3 -> ph3 -> phys3's s/lam/nu/aniso parameters. Consequence: the physics parameters are continuously shaped by 'the injected feature must be smooth', which makes it cheapest for the optimizer to RAISE l (make the field DC) rather than smooth the backbone -- a self-reinforcing loop. v111 measured exactly that: band_frac_mean = 0.0968 (90% of the field's energy still in DC), raw_lambda_c_px = 7.627, raw_ratio_mean = 1.4736; and v111 therefore ARCHIVED the additive injection channel ('the field output is a filtered copy of the backbone feature map => informationally redundant'). v113 moves pinn's action point to h2 = the layer2 output, i.e. BEFORE gate2 injects the FIRST physics field, so pinn's gradient can no longer reach ANY physics parameter (topological cut, not a scalar reweighting: changing PINN_WEIGHT would only shrink the field-parameter gradient proportionally, and the scalar-tweak family is already dead). This realizes v36's principle that physics may only act as a PASSIVE prior. MEASURED FACT (real model, non-zero input, per-parameter grads): on the OLD action point deep, pinn sends gradient to phys2/phys3 lam_param (0.31/0.90), nu_param (0.27/0.79) and aniso_param (0.39/0.94) => the physics parameters ARE continuously shaped by 'the injected feature must be smooth'. Moving the action point to the layer3 output is NOT enough: the gradient still leaks back to phys2 (2.3e-2) through layer3->layer2->gate2->ph2. Only the layer2 output (before gate2 injects the first field) disconnects BOTH fields. SEPARATE MEASURED FACT: s_param receives exactly ZERO gradient on every action point (torch.clamp(s_vals, 0.3, 1.3) saturates at the initial value) => the field smoothness exponent s has never been trainable through pinn. WHY THIS IS A FALSIFICATION TEST, NOT JUST A TWEAK: v111's archival rests on an implicit premise -- that the field is a 'copy' because the physics parameters are continuously shaped by the data/loss toward matching the backbone features. If the pinn -> physics-parameter path is cut, the field should stop being a copy, and the injection channel could revive => v111's archival conclusion would be falsified. If the field is STILL near-DC after the cut, the archival is REINFORCED (redundancy is structural, and the remaining culprit is the other constraint path, w_phys * smooth). FORWARD IS BITWISE UNCHANGED: pinn only enters the loss (PINN_WEIGHT * pinn_reg), never the forward values => same weights give identical logits => this version changes ONLY the gradient path. CRITERION (pre-registered): pass_line = 97.838 (= v110 delivered 97.50 + 2*sigma_diff, sigma_diff = 0.169 from the four-pair zero-change RMS); redline = 97.04; mechanism delivery requires the physics-parameter gradient fraction under the new action point to be <= 1e-6 while the old action point's fraction is > 0 (the probe must not be blind); band_frac_mean >= 0.20 means the field recovered content (v111 measured 0.0968). EXPECTATION (pre-registered, from discipline 336 '末态吸引子律'): precision NULL is expected, because this is still a trajectory-reshaping constraint edit; the ONLY mechanism that could refute that expectation is the field regaining content, which is exactly what the band_frac readout measures.

v110_sam.axis: v110 = cnn10_v103.py training math + ONE axis: SOBOLEV-METRIC SAM. The SAM trust region ball (Euclidean) is replaced by the metric induced by the network's own Bessel potential operator, K(k) = (1 + (lam/nu)|k|^2)^{-s}, taken from the field's running lam/nu statistics (pooled) - zero new parameters, zero new RNG in the metric. The ascent direction is eps = rho * K*g / ||K*g||_2 (K acts on the two spatial dims of conv kernels only), and the update uses the gradient at w+eps. Nothing else moves: no lr / momentum / mixup-strength scalar is touched. WHY (v109 readout = NULL, 2026-10-23): six consecutive versions across three action surfaces (feature injection v103-v105, optimizer scalars v106-v108, data side v109) are all NULL or negative, and diagnosed defects are shared - (a) the control signal smooth is ITSELF inside the loss (w_phys*smooth, peak 0.15) so it is actively pushed down and any z-score degenerates into one-way drift (v107 scale_mean=1.0998, v108 mu_std=0.011 with mu_mean=0.9186, v109 NULL): the signal has no usable high-frequency content; (b) the ones that do act act on the fragile early high-lr phase (v107 -0.45pp, v108 -1.60pp early) while the tail floor-lr regime is dose-insensitive, i.e. any extra time-varying control is just a perturbation of an already tuned schedule. SAM changes WHERE we step instead of HOW FAST, and is one of the few mechanisms with a documented effect (+0.3 to 1.0pp clean accuracy) far above this line's sigma_diff=0.169 measurement floor. TECHNICAL PREREQUISITE (new pitfall 331): the line's existing _dft_axis equals the true DFT bins only for EVEN N; conv kernels are mostly 3x3 (ODD), where the old grid is off by half a bin and a constant kernel is attenuated to 0.313 instead of 1.0 - so this version carries its own parity-safe _v110_freq_axis (fftfreq + fftshift) and self-tests 'a constant kernel passes unchanged'. DISCLOSED PURITY LOSS: two forward-backward per step (~1.8-2x wall clock) and the second forward draws another StochasticDepth mask, so the RNG stream is no longer bit-comparable with v103; cross-version pairing still uses sigma_diff=0.169. ATTRIBUTION PRE-REGISTRATION: if this version gains beyond sigma_diff, the next version MUST be plain SAM (K identical 1, same rho) as the control run before claiming the Sobolev metric itself is what helped.

criterion.baseline_note: v103 的 97.42 是 selection_bias_pp=0.0475 修正前的 max-of-N 孤点；配对基线取 97.37。sigma_diff=0.169（跨版本配对 RMS）。

followup.if_DELIVERED: 作用面族成立 ⇒ 下一版把 w_phys * smooth 也沿同一思路处理（它同样在罚场输出粗糙度 ⇒ 同样会推 l 上去），并**重锚** PINN_WEIGHT。
followup.if_MECHANISM_ONLY: 作用面切成功、场也恢复内容，但精度没过 2σ 线 ⇒ 机制成立而收益不足 ⇒ 下一版**只做**『把 2σ 线换成配对口径』（同权重两种作用面读数），不再加新机制。
followup.if_CUT_NO_CONTENT: ★ 关键否证：切掉 pinn 这条路后场**仍是近常数** ⇒ 说明压 DC 的主因是**另一条约束路径**（w_phys * smooth）⇒ v111 的归档结论被**强化**（冗余是结构性的）⇒ 下一版若再动约束，必须动 w_phys 的作用面，且这是最后一张牌。
followup.if_NOT_BINDING: 轴空转（切不掉或旧路径本来就没梯度）⇒ 探针读数先查，再决定是改实现还是换轴。
followup.if_BACKTRACK: 精度触红线 ⇒ 逐字回退 cnn10_v110.py（本版是唯一改动点）。
followup.if_NULL_no_mechanism: 精度 NULL 且机制也没切成功 ⇒ 约束通道（作用面族）判死 ⇒ 下一版只能动**目标函数主项**（分类损失形式 / 标签结构 / 损失权重结构）。

v118_smoothface.axis: v118 = v117 逐字 + 唯一一根轴：`w_phys * smooth` 的作用面。旧：smooth = roughness(phys)【场输出】⇒ 梯度直达 phys 的 s/lam/nu/aniso ⇒ 场被『输出要平滑』持续塑形 ⇒ 最省事就是把 lam 推大（场变 DC）。新：smooth = roughness(x_g)【场的输入 = 骨干特征的分组均值】⇒ x_g 与任何物理参数无关 ⇒ 梯度**到不了**场参数 ⇒ 与 v113 的 pinn 同思路，切断**最后一条**『约束 → 场参数』的路径。★ 前向 logits 逐位不变（smooth 只进 loss）。★ 剂量可能变（x_g 比 phys 粗糙）⇒ 由探针自曝 smooth_level_new/old 双口径，**不重锚 w_phys**（重锚是第二个变量 ⇒ 留给下一版）。

v96_dft_grid.axis: v96 axis = DFT FREQUENCY-GRID CORRECTION on the physics field. The production grid was torch.linspace(-pi, pi, N) whose step is 2*pi/(N-1) (closed interval; -pi and +pi are the same bin listed twice), while the true fftshift-ed DFT bin spacing is 2*pi/N (half-open) with DC at index N//2. Replaced by _dft_axis(N) = arange(N)*2*pi/N - pi, which matches 2*pi*fftfreq. This is a v51 INHERITED BUG (pitfall 273/253), not a new mechanism: it restores FLIP EQUIVARIANCE -- which flip-TTA, i.e. the delivery metric, depends on exclusively -- and makes the DC gain exactly 1. torch.linspace has NO endpoint kwarg (numpy API, pitfall 275) so arange is used. All the rest is verbatim cnn10_v51.py; groups stays 8. Recipe-domain change: step 0 already differs from v51, so this is a cross-run criterion only.

Line 1 (the real one) = pre-write free-space check via os.statvfs; line 2 = atomic write via .tmp + os.replace; line 3 = python-level exception fallback + counters into this JSON. NOTE HONESTLY: try/except CANNOT catch the C++ abort that follows a partially-written torch.save (c10::Error from PyTorchStreamWriter destructor) - only line 1 prevents that by never calling torch.save when space is short. Because this run has NO resume (user decision), a core dump from any other cause still loses everything; these guards only remove the disk from the list of things that can cause one.

v100_instrument_fix.axis_this_version: v100 axis = INSTRUMENT / CRITERION CORRECTION ONLY - ZERO training-math change. No parameter, no schedule, no RNG draw, no loss term, no physics constant differs from v99; train()/test_tta() and the whole physics chain are bit-identical. What changes is the RULER, and the ruler was provably wrong in five places. (1) sigma_diff was 0.108pp estimated from a SINGLE pair (v45/v46) while the archive holds FOUR same-recipe pairs - |delta delivered| = 0.120 (v45/v46), 0.040 (v48/v49), 0.140 (v44/v54), 0.280 (v51/v55) - whose RMS is 0.169pp, i.e. the old constant UNDERSTATED the noise floor by 1.565x and made every old line too loose. sigma_diff := 0.169. (2) All derived lines are now computed from constants (PLATEAU_PASS/REDLINE, PASS_LINE_96/REDLINE_96, BACKTRACK_REDLINE) instead of hardcoded literals - v99 still had 97.27 and 97.61 as raw literals, and 97.27 was derived from a sigma of 0.06 that is not the same ruler as PLATEAU_SIGMA. (3) The lr_tail dose gate is split in two: v99 used ONE gate (`dose_delivered`) for two different channels, and v99's own data shows why that is wrong - the dose DID run for 36 epochs (ep121-156) and the plateau window (ep135-156) lies FULLY inside it, but the delivery selection landed on ep120 because TTA ties at ep120 and ep126 (both 97.44) and the rule is first-wins. So the delivery-channel blindness is an artifact of the tie-break rule, not a missing dose. (4) The argmax tie is now a machine field (best_tta_argmax_epochs / _n / tie_break_rule). (5) The delivery claim that v99's own data falsified (`expected_delivered_vs_v98: identical 97.42`, actually 97.44) is corrected in place, with the original text preserved under a *_AS_WRITTEN_AT_DELIVERY key. HONESTY NOTE: with sigma_diff = 0.169 the plateau PASS line becomes 97.80, which is ABOVE the best plateau this line has ever produced (97.4625, v48) - so a single-run plateau verdict is arithmetically pre-decided to NULL. That is the mirror image of the v47/v48 error (line too low); the deliverable of this version is the corrected ruler, not an accuracy claim. Recipe-domain change: NO. Cross-run criterion only; single-run NULL must NOT be upgraded to 'axis invalid' (needs 3 seeds).

v98_gate2_granularity.axis: v98 axis = GATE2 CHANNEL GRANULARITY. phys2 = MaternDiffusion(512ch, @16x16) goes from groups=8 to groups=64: the per-group Matern kernel (1+lam_g|k|^2/nu_g)^(-s_g) is applied to the mean of cpg=channels/groups channels, so 8->64 shrinks the block from 64 channels to 8 and yields 64 independent (s,lam,nu) triples instead of 8. Rationale from archive v56: the measured gate leverage ranking is gate1 5.3% < gate3 8.5% < gate2 11.7%, yet v52/v53/v54 all worked on gate1 (the lowest-leverage one) and gate2 has never been touched alone since v9. ATTRIBUTION PURITY: s/lam/nu params are nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(groups)) and running_* are torch.full => changing groups consumes NO RNG, so the init sequence is bit-identical to v97 and the cross-run diff is this one thing. phys1/phys3 stay at groups=8; Gate(512) is verbatim. COST: phys2 FFT calls per forward go 8 -> 64 (accepted, ~+80s per run; batched FFT is deliberately NOT used because it is not guaranteed bitwise-equal, which would smuggle in a second axis). Recipe-domain change => cross-run criterion only; single-run NULL must not be upgraded to 'axis invalid' (needs 3 seeds).
v98_gate2_granularity.negctrl_note: 负向对照（两个方向，均由执行级自证实测）：(a) 能红的方向 —— s_param / lam_param / nu_param 全为 nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(groups))，phase_bias / dynamic_bias 是标量广播 ⇒ 第 0 步这三个参数张量的跨组 std **精确为 0.0**（实测 C5）。所以 'max(std_s, std_lam, std_nu) >= 1e-3' **能红**，不是同义反复（覆辙 267）。★ 精确起见：running_s/running_lam/running_nu 是 f32 的 torch.full（64 个同一值），其 std 实测为 **5.96e-08 而非 0**（f32 两遍归约的舍入，覆辙 272 的新形态）——故判据**只用 s/lam/nu 三个 param 的 std**，不读 running_*；阈值 1e-3 比该噪声大 4 个数量级。(b) 另一个方向 —— 把 PHYS2_GROUPS 改回 8，phys2.groups 就不等于 phys2_groups_target ⇒ 判词立刻 GRAN_GROUPS_NOT_APPLIED。

v101_anisotropy.axis: v102 = v101 **逐字不动**的训练数学 + 纯仪器修复（覆铣 #312）；the axis itself is UNCHANGED from v101: ANISOTROPIC MATERN KERNEL (re-opening the v90 axis on corrected instruments). MaternDiffusion's radial kernel (1+lam*|k|^2/nu)^(-s) with |k|^2 = kx^2+ky^2 becomes k_sq_g = kx^2 + a_g*ky^2, a_g = 1.0 + 1.0*tanh(aniso_param_g) in (0,2], applied ONLY to the two MaternDiffusion modules (phys2 512ch groups=64, phys3 1024ch groups=8); FixedDiffusion (phys1) has no directional DOF and is untouched. Attribution purity: aniso_param is nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(groups)) - zeros init consumes NO RNG (measured: the RNG state is bitwise unchanged) so the model init sequence is bit-identical to v100, and tanh(0)=0 exactly so a_g == 1.0 exactly and the step-0 kernel is bit-identical to v100's kx^2+ky^2 (measured: 1.0*t returns t exactly in IEEE-754). No cross term (no kx*ky) => the kernel is even in kx and ky separately => flip-equivariant on both axes => the flip-TTA delivery channel is protected. v90's two red lights were adjudicated as SELF-TEST false reds (float32 tanh(10) saturates to exactly 1.0 so a == 2.0 exactly; on the OLD dft grid even the isotropic kernel was not equivariant, 5.7e-2@8x8) - both are now CALIBRATED in _aniso_selftest (saturation is documented expected behaviour at param=ANISO_TANH_SAT_PARAM; equivariance is measured on the corrected _dft_axis grid with a 40x margin over the measured 2.4e-7 f32 noise). v90's mechanism readout was valid (max|a-1|=0.283 => the optimizer really pushed). v101's real run (2026-10-18) was adjudicated: accuracy NULL (delivered 97.48; every delta inside sigma_diff=0.169 => DO_NOT_BACKTRACK, and a single NULL must NOT be upgraded to 'axis invalid' - that needs 3 seeds) and mechanism ANISO_DELIVERED (phys2 max|a-1|=0.474, phys3=0.180, 162/163 epochs moved, no saturation) - BUT that verdict was computed with a BROKEN instrument: _aniso_selftest took a device argument that applied only to its INPUT tensors while every constructed module stayed on CPU => on CUDA the selftest crashed at case2 after 7 of 15 cases, and its all_pass formula (denominator = cases run before the crash) still printed '7/7 ALL PASS' (pitfall #312). v102 fixes exactly that and NOTHING else: every module construction goes through _on_dev(m, dev), the rep carries a completed flag with the denominator pinned to the expected case count (ANISO_SELFTEST_CASES / DFT_SELFTEST_CASES), and the verdict gains a selftest-error tier. Training math is bitwise identical to v101 (measured: MaternDiffusion class md5 unchanged, RNG-site multiset unchanged, .to(dev) consumes no RNG). NOT done this version: removing ModeController's dead mode_weights computation (its two Conv2d inits consume RNG => that is a seed swap, not an attributable axis).

v101_anisotropy.negctrl_note: 负向对照（三个方向，均由执行级自证实测）：(a) 第 0 步逐位相同**能红** —— case0d 把 aniso_param 置 0.5 后 a 必须 != 1；(b) 等变判据**能红** —— case2c 拿错轴的翻转做对照，差必须 > 容差（否则输出全零之类也能'通过'等变检查，覆铣 267）；(c) f32 饱和是**预期不是失败** —— case1b 断言 tanh(10) 在 f32 下精确等于 1.0 ⇒ a 精确等于 2.0；v90 的旧自测期望'a 严格小于 2'，必然被饱和咬成假红。
v101_anisotropy.note: ★ 这是**机制级**判词，与精度无关，单跑即可判。精度另走跨跑口径（PASS>=97.80 / 红线<=97.12，σ_diff=0.169pp，全部由常量派生）；档案已定案跨跑比精度不可判，单跑 NULL 不得升级为'轴无效'（需 3 seed）。

v99_crash_fix.axis_this_version: v99 = NO NEW AXIS. This version exists solely to fix a P0 crash that destroyed v98's entire JSON: `_v98_gran` was referenced INSIDE the `results = {...}` literal (L3644) but only bound at L3704 - a module-level USED_BEFORE_BOUND, the exact shape of v93's `json_dict` (pitfall 279). Training math is bit-identical to v98: no parameter, no schedule, no RNG draw, no loss term changed. Expected delivered = 97.42 (exact repeat of v98 under seed 1234); a deviation is evidence of NON-DETERMINISM, not of an axis effect. The gate2-granularity axis of v98 is RECORDED AS UNJUDGED (its mechanism readout died with the JSON) by user decision - v99 does not spend 7.5h re-running to recover it. Structural fix: the results literal no longer references any post-hoc name; readouts are computed after construction and attached by assignment, each wrapped in _safe_readout; the main results are written to *_core.json BEFORE any post-hoc readout runs.
v99_crash_fix.bug: USED_BEFORE_BOUND at module level (pitfall 279, same shape as v93)
v99_crash_fix.symptom: NameError: name '_v98_gran' is not defined (loss.mmm1.py L3644), raised AFTER a full 180-epoch run => entire JSON lost
v99_crash_fix.root_cause: `results = {` is at L3453 and references _v98_gran at L3644, but the name is only bound at L3704 (251 lines later). Structural cause: two rules held at once - 'readout must come after the delivery chain' and 'readout must go into the JSON' - are mutually exclusive inside one dict literal. Note the same file already used the CORRECT pattern (`results['disk_guard'] = {...}`) two blocks up.
v99_crash_fix.fix: results literal no longer references any post-hoc name; the readout is computed AFTER construction and attached by assignment; every post-hoc readout is wrapped in _safe_readout.
v99_crash_fix.why_not_just_move_the_assignment: Moving it earlier fixes this one instance but leaves the pattern intact - the next version that adds a readout to the literal hits the same wall. Assignment-after-construction makes the whole class of bug structurally impossible.
extra_guards: main results written to *_core.json BEFORE any post-hoc readout runs
all post-hoc readouts wrapped in _safe_readout (assembly cannot kill the run)
verdict echoed to stdout (dual channel: JSON may die, stdout cannot)
namescope (module-level binding) check integrated into the deploy checker
v99_crash_fix.expected_delivered_vs_v98_AS_WRITTEN_AT_: identical (97.42); a deviation is evidence of non-determinism, not of an axis effect
v99_crash_fix.expected_delivered_vs_v98_CORRECTED_BY_V: WRONG AS ORIGINALLY WRITTEN. v99 actually ran delivered = 97.44 (best_tta 97.44 @ep120, plateau 97.3763), NOT 97.42. Two honest readings and they are NOT the same claim: (a) v99's training math IS bit-identical to v98 (no parameter/schedule/RNG/loss change), so the +0.02pp is run-to-run noise on the SAME code path; (b) but 'bit-identical code' does NOT buy 'bit-identical result' on this platform - pitfall 141 (same-seed non-determinism, measured three times) plus cudnn/cuBLAS non-associativity. => NEVER write 'expected identical to <number>' as a delivery claim again; write 'statistically indistinguishable at sigma_diff' and let the measurement speak. v100 carries the same discipline for v99: see v100_instrument_fix.expected_delivered_vs_v99.
